title: New Year greeting 2027
hook: Happy New Year from all of us at Galvor.
caption:
Happy New Year from all of us at Galvor.

Thank you for reading, replying and arguing with us in the comments this past year. We learned from it.

Here is to a 2027 with good health, kind colleagues and work you are proud of.

See you on the other side of the long weekend.
alt_text: Festival card in Galvor violet and gold with a fireworks motif. It reads Happy New Year, then: good health, kind colleagues and work you are proud of. Below: from all of us at Galvor.

slides.headline: Good health, kind colleagues and *work you are proud of*.
slides.sub: From all of us at Galvor.

notes:
Greeting only, no marketing lesson. No numbers used. 1 Jan 2027 is a Friday, hence "long weekend"; cut that line if the team prefers.
